text_block_list.name: Matikanetanhoisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, ahahaha...!
Jeez, that was seriously hilarious...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah, please don't laugh at me that much~!
It's embarrassing...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetanhoisa
text_block_list.text:
S-Sorry... Ehehehehe!
I'm just so happy, I couldn't help it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetanhoisa
text_block_list.text:
Wait... You decorated our dorm room like this because
today's my birthday, right?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
W-Well, yeah... um, it basically ended up
looking like I just hung up every flashy lucky
charm I could get my hands on, but still...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, it went way past "festive"
and turned into kind of a "wild" scene,
giving everyone a huge laugh first thing in the morning, though...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetanhoisa
text_block_list.text:
But Matikanefukukitaru-senpai already celebrated
it with me, so it's all good!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetanhoisa
text_block_list.text:
It's so fun, so exciting,
and of course it makes me super happy~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetanhoisa
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Aw, geez, if anyone should be crying,
it's me, Fukuchan-senpai!
